name: Sorry About the Mess
source:
You went to your favorite bakery every day for years, made friends with the owners, Mara and Colin, and even got yourself a nickname, Crumb. (Seriously though, those crumble cookies are the best!)

But Colin has disappeared, leaving Mara all alone, stress-baking in a hot mess of a kitchen. You’re a good friend, so you make a house visit. Will you investigate Colin, comfort your friend, or something more?

[From [url=https://jitterrue.itch.io/sorry-about-mess]itch.io[/url]]
